The 2021 ICPC Asia Shenyang Regional Contest

A. A Bite of Teyvat
double add_circle(int X, int R);
- Add circle center at (X, 0) with radius R.
- Return circle union area.

B. Bitwise Exclusive-OR Sequence
int minimum_sum(int N, edge[] E);
- Given an unknown array A of length N.
- XOR of two ends of E[i] should be the weight.
- Find the minimum sum of the array.

C. Cards of Magic
int magic_cards(int N);
- Card I. Put on field, attack 1 HP each subsequent card casted.
- Card II. Attack 2 HP immediately.
- Card III. Copy any card casted.
- Returns minimum expected number of turns if play optimally upon random cards.

D. Cross the Maze
(int, string)[] escape_maze(int R, int C, int N, point[] S, point[] E);
- Given a R-by-C empty board and N pieces at S[i].
- Move the pieces simulatenously bijectively to E[j] without colliding pieces with minimum time.

E. Edward Gaming, the Champion
int count_substring(string S);
- Count the number of occurrences of edgnb in S.

F. Encoded Strings I
string greatest_prefix(string S);
- encode(string S): substitute each character by # of distinct characters appears later.
- Find greatest encoded prefix.

G. Encoded Strings II
string greatest_subsequence(string S);
- encode(string S): substitute each character by # of distinct characters appears later.
- Find greatest encoded subsequence.

H. Line Graph Matching
int maximum_weighted_matching(int N, int M, edge[] E);
- Find the maximum weighted matching of the line graph.

I. Linear Fractional Transformation
int linear_fractional(C z1, C w1, C z2, C w2, C z3, C w3);
- Given an unknown linear fractional f where f(zk) = wk for k = 1, 2 or 3.
- Find f(z0).

J. Luggage Lock
int rotate(int[] A, int[] B);
- Find minimum time to rotate luggage lock from state A to state B.

K. Matrix Operations
int[] max_elements(int X, int Y, int[] Z);
- Find maximum, and increase value by Z in the four quadrants cut by (X, Y).

L. Perfect Matchings
int[] perfect_matchings(int N, edge[] E);
- Given a complete graph G and deletes a tree of 2N - 1 edges E[i].
- Count number of perfect matchings in G.

M. String Problem
(int, int)[] largest_substring(string S);
- Find (leftmost) largest substring for each prefix of S.
